title: Temperature Rising
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Mizumo, abandoned by his parents, has been selling sex to teachers at school to raise his younger brothers. When his childhood friend Minori finds out, he offers to become Mizumo's "customer" himself, and the paid arrangement slowly turns into love (Juné blurb via AniList; MU). Reader reviews place both boys in high school and describe a happy ending (Goodreads).
life_message: Being truly cared for can pull someone out of a life they entered to survive.
